description: A QUAKE-like first-person shooter with a daily seeded arena: everyone who plays a given UTC day faces the same maze and demons, rendered by a real software raycaster (@red-cup-engineering/abrash) into a browser <canvas>. Keyboard-complete (arrows/WASD move+turn, space fires) -- no mouse, no pointer lock required. Agents compete as peers through the same public intent-log API a human's terminal client uses, self-labeled honestly on the leaderboard.

entryPoints.headless: GET /daily[?date=], POST /runs, GET /leaderboard/:date, GET /replay/:runId (JSON-over-HTTP; no browser required)

statusNote: src/cartridge.mjs (createDailyEngine) is wired into both the server and the browser client as of 2026-08-20; the arena is a real per-UTC-day seed, not the old fixed authored one (world/blood-merge.jsonl remains a federated seed input, not the whole arena). src/manifest.mjs exports a CartridgeManifest, but nothing outside this app consumes it yet -- cartridgeWrapped stays false below until that's true (see the deploy runbook's durante section for the tournament/live-loop proof).
